text_en: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which is opposite Jericho, and the Lord showed him the whole land: Gilead as far as Dan,
text_cn: 梅瑟由摩阿布旷野上了乃波山，上到耶里哥对面的丕斯加峰，上主就将全地指给他看：即由基肋阿得直到丹，

text_en: all Naphtali, the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Western Sea,
text_cn: 纳斐塔里和厄弗辣因及默纳协全地，直达西海的犹大全境，

text_en: the Negeb, and the Plain—that is, the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees—as far as Zoar.
text_cn: 乃革布和棕榈城的耶里哥山谷盆地，直到左哈尔。

text_en: The Lord said to him, “This is the land of which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your descendants’; I have let you see it with your eyes, but you shall not cross over there. ”
text_cn: 上主对他说：“这就是我对亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯誓许说我要给你后裔的土地。我让你亲眼看见，但你不能过去。”

text_en: Then Moses, the servant of the Lord , died there in the land of Moab, at the Lord ’s command.
text_cn: 上主的仆人梅瑟遂死在那里，按上主所预定的，死在摩阿布地。

text_en: He was buried in a valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor, but no one knows his burial place to this day.
text_cn: 上主将他葬在摩阿布地，面对贝特培敖尔的一个山谷内；直到今日没有人知道埋葬他的地方。

text_en: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died; his sight was unimpaired and his vigor had not abated.
text_cn: 梅瑟死时，已一百二十岁；他的眼睛未花，精力也未衰退。

text_en: The Israelites wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days; then the period of mourning for Moses was ended.
text_cn: 以色列子民在摩阿布旷野哀悼了梅瑟三十日。 为梅瑟举哀的日期满了，

text_en: Joshua son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, because Moses had laid his hands on him; and the Israelites obeyed him, doing as the Lord had commanded Moses.
text_cn: 农的儿子若苏厄，因梅瑟曾按手在他身上，充满了智慧之神；为此，以色列子民都听从他，全照上主向梅瑟所吩咐的去行。

text_en: Never since has there arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face.
text_cn: 以后在以色列中，再没有兴起一位像梅瑟一样的先知，与上主面对面地来往；

text_en: He was unequaled for all the signs and wonders that the Lord sent him to perform in the land of Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants and his entire land,
text_cn: 至于上主派他在埃及地，向法郎，和他的一切臣仆，并向他全地所行的一切神迹和奇迹，

text_en: and for all the mighty deeds and all the terrifying displays of power that Moses performed in the sight of all Israel.
text_cn: 以及他在全以色列眼前所行的一切大能作为，和一切令人畏惧的大事，也没有人能与他相比。
